name: Second War
summary: Across the Eastern Kingdoms, the Second War rages between the Orcish Horde and the newly forged Alliance of Lordaeron. After Stormwind falls, battle sweeps through Khaz Modan and the northern human realms, then reaches the gates of Capital City. The war ends when the Dark Portal is destroyed and the old Horde is scattered.

sections.title: A Continent at War
sections.body:
After Stormwind fell in the First War, Regent Anduin Lothar led human refugees north across the Great Sea to Lordaeron. King Terenas Menethil II called the Council of Seven Nations and forged the Alliance of Lordaeron. The high elves of Quel'Thalas, the Bronzebeard dwarves of Ironforge, and the gnomes of Gnomeregan joined it.

Across the sea, Warchief Orgrim Doomhammer gathered the Horde. He allied with forest troll tribes and the Steamwheedle Cartel. The Dragonmaw clan brought red dragons under Horde control for the invasion of the northern continents.

sections.title: The Invasion of the North
sections.body:
The Horde struck by land and sea, swiftly overrunning Khaz Modan. Dwarves and gnomes fell back behind the sealed gates of Ironforge and Gnomeregan. Horde forces crossed the Thandol Span and the seas, burning through Hillsbrad and the Hinterlands before laying siege to Capital City.

Alterac betrayed the Alliance and guided orc divisions through mountain passes. Dragon attacks battered the defenders, but the Alliance rallied around the newly formed Knights of the Silver Hand. Their paladins wielded the Holy Light against orcish warlocks and death knights.

sections.title: The Turning Tide and the Dark Portal
sections.body:
The war turned when the warlock Gul'dan left the Horde with his followers to seek personal power. Doomhammer had to draw vital forces away from the front lines. The Alliance counterattacked, broke the siege of Lordaeron, and drove the Horde south across the Thandol Span, freeing Khaz Modan along the way.

In the final mountain passes of the Burning Steppes, Anduin Lothar fell in single combat against Doomhammer. Lothar's lieutenant Turalyon rallied the troops and routed the orcs. The Alliance pursued the survivors to the Black Morass, shattered the remnants, and demolished the Dark Portal.

faq.q: How did the Second War begin?
aliases: why did the second war start
faq.answer: After the Horde razed Stormwind in the First War, Orgrim Doomhammer saw that the northern human realms would eventually strike back. He chose to attack before humanity could organize. At the same time, Stormwind refugees led by Anduin Lothar warned King Terenas Menethil II of Lordaeron, prompting the creation of the Alliance of Lordaeron.

The Alliance of Lordaeron won a decisive victory. Its forces drove the Horde from Capital City and south through Khaz Modan, then defeated Warchief Orgrim Doomhammer at the foot of Blackrock Mountain. They dismantled the Dark Portal in the Black Morass.

faq.q: What happened to Khaz Modan during the fighting?
faq.answer: The Horde overran Khaz Modan's surface lands to seize its rich mineral deposits and forges. The Bronzebeard dwarves and their gnomish allies destroyed mountain passes and tunnels to slow the advance, then retreated behind the sealed gates of Ironforge and Gnomeregan. The Horde besieged Ironforge but could not breach its gates before the Alliance pushed south and freed the realm.

faq.q: Why did the Horde lose when they reached Capital City?
faq.answer: At the height of the siege of Lordaeron's capital, the warlock Gul'dan abandoned the front line with the Stormreaver and Twilight's Hammer clans to hunt for ancient demonic power. Doomhammer split his army to punish the deserters, fatally weakening the siege lines just as the Alliance counterattack struck.

Sir Anduin Lothar was the Lion of Azeroth and Regent of Stormwind after King Llane's assassination. He led the survivors north and became Supreme Commander of the Alliance armies. Near the war's end, Lothar died in single combat against Orgrim Doomhammer in the Burning Steppes, inspiring Turalyon to lead the Alliance to victory.

faq.q: Where did the final battle take place?
faq.answer: The decisive battle between the armies took place around Blackrock Mountain in the Burning Steppes, where Doomhammer was defeated. The surviving orcs fled to the Black Morass, where the Alliance fought a final engagement at the Dark Portal. They demolished its stone framework and imprisoned or scattered the remaining Horde clans.

angles.text: As a member of the Alliance, you stand with the union of humans, dwarves, gnomes, and elves forged in the Second War against an existential threat.

As a member of the Horde, you inherit a people marked by the collapse of the old blood-cursed Horde. That collapse led directly to the internment camps and the eventual rebirth of the new Horde under Thrall.

As a paladin, you follow the path of the Knights of the Silver Hand. Archbishop Alonsus Faol and Uther the Lightbringer founded them during this conflict to oppose the fel magic and death knights of the Horde.
As a dwarf, you come from Khaz Modan, which suffered widespread devastation during the war. It endured a long Horde siege behind Ironforge's sealed mountain gates until Alliance armies lifted it.
